title: Cover Step Added for Coverage in Force on the Piece
content:
# Tariff Rider: The Cover Step Added for Coverage in Force on a Piece

This rider fixes the step added to the basis figure of a piece at the bench of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service by reference to the coverage the piece carries under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans: how that coverage stands, and whether a claim has been settled against it.

| The coverage records show | Step added to the basis figure |
|---|---|
| Coverage on the piece stands in force and no claim has been settled against it | the full cover step, 15 percent |
| Coverage on the piece stands in force and a claim has been settled against it | the reduced cover step, 8 percent |
| Any other case | no step is added on this ground |

**The rider in words.** Where coverage on the piece stands in force and no claim has been settled against it, the full cover step of 15 percent is added; where coverage stands in force and a claim has been settled against it, the reduced cover step of 8 percent is added. In any other case no step is added on this ground.

**On the records.** Both clauses require the coverage to stand in force; where it stands otherwise, neither step is added however many claims have been settled. The claims counted are those settled against that coverage over its whole life, not only those of the last year.

**A hypothetical reading.** A piece with a basis figure of 6,000.00 USD carrying coverage in force against which no claim has been settled takes the full cover step of 15 percent. With one claim settled against that coverage, it takes the reduced cover step of 8 percent. Where the coverage has expired, no step is added on this ground.
